text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that the Community Council not authorize the installation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Havendale Road and Scotland Road/Roker Crescent as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This intersection currently has a stop control for the northbound movement on Roker Crescent and the southbound movement on Scotland Road at Havendale Road.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Havendale Road and Scotland Road/Roker Crescent.
